blocks.text: Agot Isidro credited her curiosity and her longstanding relationship with manager Shirley Kuan for helping sustain her 34-year career in show business. Isidro marked her 34th year in the entertainment industry with a thanksgiving press conference on Tuesday, Sept. 29. Despite her decades-long career, the singer-actress said she remains curious about things related to her work. “Hindi resilience. I think curiosity,” Isidro told reporters when asked to name the secret to her longevity. “Gusto ko i-approach each project with curious eyes. Para iba-iba ‘yung flavor.” Isidro has kept a busy schedule this year, appearing in five films: “Ganito, Ganiyan, Ganoon,” “Mag-iina,” […]...
